# Search quality — 7 days to 2026-09-18

*2026-09-11 05:33:45 to 2026-09-18 05:33:45*

Search handled 75 searches this period at a health score of 70.2/100. That is down 0.9 points on the previous period. 18 queries are failing badly enough to need attention, and 6 of the flagged terms are products the catalogue stocks but search did not surface.

## What changed

| Metric | Previous | This period | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Health score | 71.1 | 70.2 | -0.9 (worse) |
| Searches | 77 | 75 | -2 |
| Failing queries | 17 | 18 | +1 (worse) |
| Zero-result rate | 11.7% | 6.7% | -5.0 pp (better) |
| Irrelevant-result rate | 10.4% | 16.0% | +5.6 pp (worse) |
| Under-filled rate | 41.6% | 37.3% | -4.2 pp (better) |
| Retrieval gaps | 6 | 6 | +0 |

## Searches that came back empty

6.7% of searches returned nothing at all.

| Query | Searches | Empty | Catalogue | Cause |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| “kombucha” | 1 | 1 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “زعفران” | 1 | 1 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “quinoa” | 1 | 1 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “wasabi” | 1 | 1 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “كينوا” | 1 | 1 | not stocked | assortment gap |

## What needs attention

**1. “دجاج”** — 5 searches, severity 0.37
- Only 4.2 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 100% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**2. “زبا”** **(new this period)** — 2 searches, severity 0.93
- 100% of searches returned nothing that mentions the query.
- Only 2.0 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 100% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.
- No product in the catalogue uses this word or anything close to it, so this may be an assortment gap rather than a search fault.

**3. “pas”** **(new this period)** — 2 searches, severity 0.84
- 100% of searches returned nothing that mentions the query.
- Results are scattered across unrelated categories (33% share a category).
- Only 3.0 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 100% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.
- No product in the catalogue uses this word or anything close to it, so this may be an assortment gap rather than a search fault.

**4. “شاي”** — 3 searches, severity 0.42
- Only 3.7 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 50% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**5. “خبز”** **(new this period)** — 3 searches, severity 0.34
- Only 3.7 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 50% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

## Awaiting review

34 proposals are pending (8 misspelling, 1 partial query, 25 synonym). Strongest first:

- `chicken` → `دجاج` (synonym, confidence 0.84)
- `milk` → `حليب` (synonym, confidence 0.84)
- `فاراوله` → `فراوله` (misspelling, confidence 0.80)
- `فراولت` → `فراوله` (misspelling, confidence 0.80)
- `chiken` → `chicken` (misspelling, confidence 0.78)

None of these are applied until a reviewer approves and exports them.

## How to read these numbers

- No click or order data exists in this dataset, so engagement is inferred from whether shoppers searched again. Searches that ended a session are excluded rather than assumed successful.
- 4% of searches were re-fired within two seconds with identical results and look automated rather than human; they are excluded from the engagement figures.
